library.name: GSAP
library.description: GreenSock Animation Platform — high-performance JavaScript animation toolkit. Metadata/catalog only; do not redistribute GSAP source.
library.license_note: GSAP Standard No Charge License — free for most commercial use; library source must not be redistributed.

items.name: Timeline
items.description: Sequence and synchronize tweens with precise control over timing, labels, and nested timelines.

items.name: ScrollTrigger
items.description: Pin, scrub, and trigger animations based on scroll position. Core pattern for scroll storytelling.

items.name: SplitText (note)
items.description: Split text into characters, words, or lines for staggered typography animations. Club plugin historically; check current licensing for SplitText availability.

items.name: Stagger
items.description: Offset animation start times across multiple targets with stagger objects for grids and lists.

items.name: fromTo tweens
items.description: Explicitly set both start and end states with gsap.fromTo for predictable entrance and exit motion.

items.name: matchMedia / reduced motion
items.description: Create responsive animation contexts with gsap.matchMedia and respect prefers-reduced-motion breakpoints.
items.accessibility_notes: Use matchMedia with prefers-reduced-motion to disable or simplify motion.

items.name: gsap.context
items.description: Scope animations for React/Vue cleanup. Revert all animations created inside a context on unmount.

items.name: Nested timelines
items.description: Compose complex sequences by nesting child timelines inside a master timeline with relative positioning.
